<script lang="ts" setup>
import type { DrawerRootEmits, DrawerRootProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { DrawerRoot, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui';

const props = defineProps<DrawerRootProps>();
const emits = defineEmits<DrawerRootEmits>();

const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Trigger and content. Receives the open state and a close function.
   */
  default?: (props: { open: boolean; close: () => void }) => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <DrawerRoot
    v-slot="slotProps"
    data-slot="drawer"
    v-bind="forwarded"
  >
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </DrawerRoot>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import type { DrawerContentEmits, DrawerContentProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { DrawerContent, DrawerHandle, DrawerPortal, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui';
import DrawerOverlay from './DrawerOverlay.vue';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const props = defineProps<DrawerContentProps>();
const emits = defineEmits<DrawerContentEmits>();

const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);
</script>

<template>
  <DrawerPortal>
    <DrawerOverlay />
    <DrawerContent
      data-slot="drawer-content"
      class="sigma-ui-drawer-content"
      v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...$attrs }"
      :class="[$attrs.class]"
    >
      <DrawerHandle class="sigma-ui-drawer-content__handle" />
      <slot />
    </DrawerContent>
  </DrawerPortal>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-drawer-content {
  position: fixed;
  z-index: 50;
  display: flex;
  height: auto;
  flex-direction: column;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  background-color: var(--background);
  transform: translate3d(var(--drawer-swipe-movement-x, 0), var(--drawer-swipe-movement-y, 0), 0);
  transition: transform 500ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);
  will-change: transform;
}

.sigma-ui-drawer-content[data-swiping] {
  transition-duration: 0ms;
  user-select: none;
}

.sigma-ui-drawer-content[data-swipe-direction="down"] {
  bottom: 0;
  max-height: 80vh;
  margin-top: 6rem;
  border-top-left-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  border-top-right-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  inset-inline: 0;
}

.sigma-ui-drawer-content[data-swipe-direction="up"] {
  top: 0;
  max-height: 80vh;
  margin-bottom: 6rem;
  border-bottom-left-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  border-bottom-right-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  inset-inline: 0;
}

.sigma-ui-drawer-content[data-swipe-direction="left"],
.sigma-ui-drawer-content[data-swipe-direction="right"] {
  width: 75%;
  max-width: 24rem;
  inset-block: 0;
}

.sigma-ui-drawer-content[data-swipe-direction="left"] {
  left: 0;
}

.sigma-ui-drawer-content[data-swipe-direction="right"] {
  right: 0;
}

.sigma-ui-drawer-content[data-swipe-direction="down"][data-state="open"] {
  animation: sigma-ui-drawer-in-bottom 500ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);
}

.sigma-ui-drawer-content[data-swipe-direction="down"][data-state="closed"] {
  animation: sigma-ui-drawer-out-bottom 500ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);
}

.sigma-ui-drawer-content[data-swipe-direction="up"][data-state="open"] {
  animation: sigma-ui-drawer-in-top 500ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);
}

.sigma-ui-drawer-content[data-swipe-direction="up"][data-state="closed"] {
  animation: sigma-ui-drawer-out-top 500ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);
}

.sigma-ui-drawer-content[data-swipe-direction="left"][data-state="open"] {
  animation: sigma-ui-drawer-in-left 500ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);
}

.sigma-ui-drawer-content[data-swipe-direction="left"][data-state="closed"] {
  animation: sigma-ui-drawer-out-left 500ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);
}

.sigma-ui-drawer-content[data-swipe-direction="right"][data-state="open"] {
  animation: sigma-ui-drawer-in-right 500ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);
}

.sigma-ui-drawer-content[data-swipe-direction="right"][data-state="closed"] {
  animation: sigma-ui-drawer-out-right 500ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);
}

.sigma-ui-drawer-content__handle {
  display: none;
  width: 100px;
  height: 0.5rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  margin-top: 1rem;
  background-color: var(--muted);
  margin-inline: auto;
}

.sigma-ui-drawer-content[data-swipe-direction="down"] .sigma-ui-drawer-content__handle {
  display: block;
}

@keyframes sigma-ui-drawer-in-bottom {
  from {
    translate: 0 100%;
  }
}

@keyframes sigma-ui-drawer-out-bottom {
  to {
    translate: 0 100%;
  }
}

@keyframes sigma-ui-drawer-in-top {
  from {
    translate: 0 -100%;
  }
}

@keyframes sigma-ui-drawer-out-top {
  to {
    translate: 0 -100%;
  }
}

@keyframes sigma-ui-drawer-in-left {
  from {
    translate: -100% 0;
  }
}

@keyframes sigma-ui-drawer-out-left {
  to {
    translate: -100% 0;
  }
}

@keyframes sigma-ui-drawer-in-right {
  from {
    translate: 100% 0;
  }
}

@keyframes sigma-ui-drawer-out-right {
  to {
    translate: 100% 0;
  }
}
</style>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import type { DrawerDescriptionProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { DrawerDescription } from 'reka-ui';

const props = defineProps<DrawerDescriptionProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <DrawerDescription
    v-bind="props"
    class="sigma-ui-drawer-description"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
    data-slot="drawer-description"
  >
    <slot />
  </DrawerDescription>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-drawer-description {
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
  font-size: 0.875rem;
}
</style>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import type { DrawerOverlayProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { DrawerOverlay } from 'reka-ui';

const props = defineProps<DrawerOverlayProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <DrawerOverlay
    v-bind="props"
    class="sigma-ui-drawer-overlay"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
    data-slot="drawer-overlay"
  />
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-drawer-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  z-index: 50;
  background-color: rgb(0 0 0 / 80%);
  inset: 0;
}

.sigma-ui-drawer-overlay[data-state="open"] {
  animation: sigma-ui-drawer-fade-in 500ms ease;
}

.sigma-ui-drawer-overlay[data-state="closed"] {
  animation: sigma-ui-drawer-fade-out 500ms ease;
}

@keyframes sigma-ui-drawer-fade-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

@keyframes sigma-ui-drawer-fade-out {
  to {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}
</style>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import type { DrawerTitleProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { DrawerTitle } from 'reka-ui';

const props = defineProps<DrawerTitleProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <DrawerTitle
    v-bind="props"
    class="sigma-ui-drawer-title"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
    data-slot="drawer-title"
  >
    <slot />
  </DrawerTitle>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-drawer-title {
  font-size: 1.125rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em;
  line-height: 1;
}
</style>
